Outcome column, rows with a Latest line

rules.evidence_quote: Open a delivery to see what was recorded.

reasons: Every time shows UTC, and every visible status is a drawn mark plus one of the allowed words (Sent, Delivered, Failed, Not sent). The page is called Activity, the search sits above the list, and the partly cut-off last row is inside a scrolling table with pagination, which is allowed. Event words such as Suppressed, Bounced and Opened appear only on the "Latest:" lines and in the event filter, and no retry promise is made.
